harvest:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: four-frame EMPTY-HANDED harvesting / overhead-carry robot animation atlas for an existing pixel game.
Reference image is the exact character identity and pixel art style. Create a NEW 2 by 2 atlas (four equal square cells, row-major animation order). Transparent PNG, square canvas. Keep wide transparent gutters and at least 15% padding inside every cell. NO crops, vegetables, carrots, fruit, seeds, baskets, crates, water or cargo anywhere in this image. Empty hands in ALL FOUR frames; cargo will be a separate game layer.
Exact same reference robot: cream rounded square shell, dark teal faceplate, two mint square eyes, brass antenna, teal arms, mint hovering thruster, no legs. Same front three-quarter pose facing a little right, identical shell shape, face, size and body location in all cells. Chunky hard-edged pixel art, 3 shades per material, dark #263f3c outlines, cream #f0e4bb, teal #35665b, mint #8fc7a3, top-left lighting. No gradients or smooth vector style.
In each cell shell center stays at (50%,58%), shell width 36% of cell and height 32%, thruster bottom at 84%.
Frame top-left: harvesting reach, right empty gripper arm extends down to lower right, left arm low.
Frame top-right: right empty gripper closes, arm slightly bent lifting toward shoulder, left arm begins to rise.
Frame bottom-left: both empty arms lifting up beside face, palms turning upward.
Frame bottom-right: BOTH empty arms fully raised, gripper palms facing upward above head, palms near (35%,30%) and (65%,30%); space centered above head is completely EMPTY for a separate crop to be composited. Antenna and head remain intact. Hands must not touch each other. This is the final carry pose.
No text, labels, borders, ground, cast shadows, or objects. Complete silhouettes entirely within their own cell, no crossing grid boundaries. Preserve reference identity aggressively.
